rationale: The cluster [validate_failed::workflow-section] (task t02-chinese-alias) shows provenance is entirely missing from the produced data.json even though extraction passed. The note indicates the workflow must mandate provenance stamping as a mandatory step. By elevating the provenance requirement to a core rule (making it a fundamental property of a Data Pack), we ensure agents treat it as essential and include it during extraction or as a manual stamp.
expected_effect: Agents will treat provenance as a required structural element, similar to entities or relations, and will check and add it after extraction. In t02-chinese-alias, the agent will now include provenance in the final pack, causing the validation harness to accept the output.
regression_risk: Low. The existing four rules remain unchanged; only a fifth rule is appended. All passed tasks (t01, t03, t04) already produce packs with provenance or are unaffected by this rule addition. Core concept is already expected to guide fundamental pack structure.
